comparison.objective: Install a wardrobe rail into closed/open end supports; candidate selectively separates media from washers through a screen.
comparison.physical_skill: Rail insertion requires bimanual long-part alignment and swing-in seating, not agitation-driven size separation of loose bodies.
comparison.success_condition: Rail ends seated, level, still, released for 1 s; candidate requires ≥98% media recovery, total washer retention, reseating, clearance, and 3 s dwell.
comparison.reason: Both use bimanual support and release, but their tested transformations and failure modes are materially different; no relevant rubric detail is missing.
